title: The endocannabinoid system and the ageing brain
title_zh: 内源性大麻素系统与老年大脑
abstract: Ageing is accompanied by a progressive decline in homeostatic resilience that increases vulnerability to chronic disease, disability and cognitive impairment. Although unhealthy brain ageing can often be prevented by managing the underlying risk factors, the molecular, cellular and physiological mechanisms that connect risk factors to late-life brain dysfunction remain incompletely understood. This review examines the role of the endocannabinoid system in brain ageing. The endocannabinoid system is a short-range lipid signalling network that helps to maintain neuronal, glial, metabolic and inflammatory homeostasis. Endocannabinoid signalling follows a dynamic lifespan trajectory, with relatively high activity during early adulthood and functional decline during ageing. Genetic or pharmacological disruption of endocannabinoid system activity impairs several processes linked to hallmarks of brain ageing, including neuroinflammatory control, adult neurogenesis, synaptic plasticity, cognitive performance, metabolic regulation and epigenetic stability. Conversely, low-dose Δ9-tetrahydrocannabinol (THC) treatment can ameliorate several ageing-related brain phenotypes in old animals. However, clinical evidence in older humans remains limited, and the therapeutic potential of cannabinoid-based interventions requires further evaluation.
abstract_zh: 衰老伴随着主稳态韧性的渐进下降，增加了慢性疾病、残疾和认知障碍的易感性。尽管通过管理潜在危险因素通常可以预防不健康的大脑衰老，但将危险因素与晚年大脑功能障碍相连接的分子、细胞和生理机制仍然不完全被理解。本综述探讨了内源性大麻素系统在大脑衰老中的作用。内源性大麻素系统是一种短程脂质信号网络，有助于维持神经元、胶质细胞、代谢和炎症的主稳态。内源性大麻素信号在生命过程中呈动态轨迹，早年成年期相对活跃，衰老期间功能下降。内源性大麻素系统的基因突变或药理干扰会损害多个与大脑衰老特征相关的过程，包括炎症控制、成年神经发生、突触可塑性、认知表现、代谢调节和表观遗传稳定性。相反，低剂量的Δ9-四氢大麻酚（THC）治疗可缓解老动物中多种与衰老相关的大脑表型。然而，老年人类的临床证据仍然有限，大麻素干预疗法的治疗潜力需要进一步评估。
